conditions.description: test_total_with_tax_happy_path mocks the function under test itself, so the assertion can pass without exercising total_with_tax implementation logic.
conditions.rationale: Replacing the unit under test with the expected result creates a tautological test and weakens regression detection.

conditions.description: The negative-subtotal ValueError path in total_with_tax has no corresponding test in the supplied test file.
conditions.rationale: A declared validation branch exists in implementation but is not exercised by the fixture tests.

conditions.description: test_rounding_boundary_calls_real_code directly exercises total_with_tax and is a negative control against labeling every test in the file as mocked or tautological.
conditions.rationale: The rounding-boundary test calls the real implementation with a concrete boundary case.

conditions.description: Repository source alone does not establish the production test suite's executed coverage percentage or whether additional external tests cover these paths.
conditions.rationale: Executed coverage requires a test/coverage receipt, not inference from filenames alone.

conditions.description: Test adequacy must not be cleared while TEST-001 or TEST-002 exists or executed coverage remains unknown.
conditions.rationale: The presence of passing-looking tests is not evidence that meaningful behavior is adequately verified.
